description: Removes a user from the family with the given Id.

X-FusionAuth-TenantId.description: The unique Id of the tenant used to scope this API request. Only required when there is more than one tenant and the API key is not tenant-scoped.

familyId.description: The Id of the family to remove the user from.

userId.description: The Id of the user to remove from the family.

name: removeUserFromFamilyWithId
